center_question: What signed night−day GPS displacement q and within-tag-year q~astronomical-daylength relationships remain under three different observation schedules when we compare exactly the SAME original tagged animals and solar dates?
scope: All 8 original Movebank source study DOIs, 12 native taxon×source cohorts. Preserve old Great Egret >200MB original-file HOLD and Turkey/fishing cat no-triple-tag support. No replacement.
original_GPS_integrity: Check public original provider bitstream UUID/file bytes/MD5; replay source first q and q~daylength source-tag mean and n EXACTLY before computing new common-date original q levels. Original telemetry ephemeral, no original raw GPS redistribution.

original_observation_schedules.ORIGINAL_UTC_HOURBIN: Timestamp-only at most one original GPS fix per UTC-hour bin; actual accepted elapsed GPS step 0.5 to 2.0 hours.
original_observation_schedules.EVEN_UTC_2H: Use only original even UTC-hour bin selected fixes, actual elapsed GPS step 1.5 to 2.5 hours.
original_observation_schedules.ODD_UTC_2H: Use only original odd UTC-hour bin selected fixes, actual elapsed GPS step 1.5 to 2.5 hours.

strict_comparability: For each actual original source tagged animal and calendar year, only astronomy-qualified solar calendar days simultaneously eligible in ALL THREE schedules; at least 10 identical qualifying dates/year (at least 3 accepted day and 3 accepted night steps per schedule/day); daylength x is calculated from original full-hourbin source latitude on those days (identical x for all schedules); observational weather not requested.
q_level: Within each triple-qualified tag year, mean(log1p(median observed NIGHT GPS step km/h)−log1p(median observed DAY GPS step km/h)) on matched dates; tag level = equal mean across qualified original years. Not true hours of activity.
q_daylength_slope: Within original tagged year OLS q vs the SAME original-source astronomical daylength x for each schedule. Require >=0.5 hour spread and 10 matched dates. Tag mean over slope-qualified years. Same tag population across all THREE slopes.
data_unit: First pair original year/date, then original tagged animal, then study/taxon. Every native taxon contributes one conditional descriptive source group. Never pool 12 source×taxon as independent field studies or count original GPS fixes as iid.
bootstrap: 2000 fixed-seed original-tag resampling per source for the three q means with common original tagged animal selection (same bootstrap draw indices for q_original/even/odd) and likewise three slope means (only source tags with all slopes). >=5 matching original tags to publish source means/nominal 95% percentile intervals. Under 5 remains UNAVAILABLE, never zero.
validation_against_frozen_triplet: Per source taxon n, original same-tag-years/days support, and six group-level phase-minus-original q/slope means MUST match original archived triple-date result within 1e-12; source group HOLD and all original study/taxon denominations unmodified. No effect-sign selection.
sign_invariance: Distinguish three schedules each with a descriptive source-tag CI entirely POSITIVE or NEGATIVE, unresolved zero-spanning interval, and any mixture of POSITIVE/NEGATIVE; do not call stable sign if a CI includes zero or is unsupported. This is exploratory same-source robustness only, not equivalence nor hypothesis test of universal niche.
limitations: This route reuses originally observed studies after the earlier q and parity results were inspected, so no independent heldout ecology or preregistered sample.

Telemetry cadence, GPS path-chord length, fix missingness, astronomical sun-clock phase and day/night availability still differ between schedules; same days do not imply same physical exposure or movement events.
Sunrise/daylength association can proxy temperature, resource cycles and season; no causal photoperiodic mechanism identified.
An unresolved source animal bootstrap sign is not an estimate of exactly zero, a biological equality or an absence of temporal niche.
All study×taxon source conditional bootstrap bands nominal unadjusted for multiplicity; 8 original field studies purposively sampled and species clustered within some sources.
Original GPS individual IDs, calendar dates, coordinates, fix-level events, source original gridyears, and tagged individual coefficients must never be committed.
